content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to connect two PT100 cards to one [product_name]? I read somewhere that the PT100 card will be discontinued and replaced by another version. Have you heard anything about this? Thank you in advance!

Hi, How many PT100 cards you can use on a [product_name] depends on the model of your [product_name]. If your [product_name] base module does not have analog inputs, then you can use up to four expansion modules for analog input. If your [product_name] offers onboard analog channels, you can choose to use either two or four onboard, and the rest can be provided via expansion modules. The maximum supported analog inputs is eight. It is correct that a new module has replaced the older PT100 analog module. The new module supports PT100 and PT1000 sensors, has automatic sensor detection, and allows mixing different sensor types per module (2 Channels). Older versions of [product_name] can also work with the new module. I hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to increase analog measurement capacity with PT100 cards on [product_name] controllers. There is a focus on module compatibility, the limits of analog inputs, and awareness around product changes, particularly the shift from discontinued modules to newly available versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward options to expand analog inputs on [product_name] and timely updates about changes such as module discontinuation or replacement.
